title: Backward Scan Prefix
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $a,R,n$ be natural numbers, let $B$ be a base controller configuration, and let $u$ be an integer. Suppose the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$, and $n\le 2R+1$. After $n$ schedule steps from the backward phase with unary-counter head at $u$ and guide head at $R$, the controller remains in the backward phase and the guide head is at $R-n$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
The base guide tape equals the fixed guide of radius $R$
replaced:
Suppose the base's guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$ and let
$n \le 2R + 1$.  Running the schedule controller for $n$ steps from the backward phase
with guide head at $R$ stays in the backward phase and moves the guide head to
$R - n$.
